current_episode.title: The Broker Who Thinks Like a Landlord: Inside Texas Retail Leasing with Tooba Patoli

guest.bio_context: Tuva Patoli started in commercial real estate at age 22 after leaving a corporate salary job, drawn by the commission-based model where effort directly correlates with earnings. She developed expertise in retail leasing across the Texas market, particularly in Houston and Dallas, focusing on identifying emerging submarkets, tenant mix strategies, and bridging leasing fundamentals with investment sales. Her dual focus on both landlord and tenant representation, combined with her extensive canvassing and market knowledge, enabled her to build a third-party retail leasing team from zero to 36 represented shopping centers.

75% landlord representation, 25% tenant representation: Current practice allocation across Texas (Houston and Dallas markets)
4.5 years: Tenure in commercial real estate industry at time of podcast recording
